subject: Week 17 submission playbook + Tuesday standup agenda
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: sales-ops@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Week 17 submission playbook + Tuesday standup agenda

Team —

Quick note ahead of the week: finance needs a finalized forecast submission by EOD Wednesday (04/28). Please use the attached forecast-template-Week17.xlsx and follow the short rules in commit-guidelines-v2.pdf. Key asks:  

- Update stage and commit flag for every open ACV >= $10k. If confidence < 60% move it back to Pipeline and add a one-line reason.
- Ensure expected close date is realistic (do not leave as quarter-end unless validated with the customer).
- Mark any deals that require legal/procurement review in the "Blockers" column.

Tuesday standup (04/27) agenda:  
1) Quick intake: deals with late paperwork (2 min per rep)
2) Commit review: highlight top 6 deals under commit for calibration
3) ARR reconciliation: any material changes to ARR assumptions
4) Action items and ownership (roll forward)

Please come prepared with your top 6 commits and a one-line justification for each. I’ll run the call at 9:30am PT — calendar invite will follow. If you have an external coordination item (e.g., procurement terms) flagged to finance, copy finance@acmecorp.com or the rep contact.

Attachments: forecast-template-Week17.xlsx (sheet per rep), commit-guidelines-v2.pdf

Thanks —
Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com
Mobile: (415) 555-0186

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Week 17 submission playbook + Tuesday standup agenda

Thanks, Irene — noted. Two quick clarifications:  

1) For the "commit" justification, are we using the 3-point rubric (customer verbal, PO in-flight, contract signed) from the guidelines, or is a short narrative okay?
2) I have one deal (Brightleaf) that looks like commit but procurement wants a 60-day data residency addendum. Should I mark it as Commit-Pending and include Sarah on the Tuesday call?

I’ll populate my sheet by EOD Wed but can push the Brightleaf row earlier if helpful.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 07:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Week 17 submission playbook + Tuesday standup agenda

Looping in my top commits for the call. Copying the one-line rationales inline to save time:  

- BR-1483 | Brightleaf Analytics | $68,000 ACV | Commit-Pending — Legal needs data residency addendum; finance engaged; customer verbally committed 04/20.
- AC-222 | Acme Corp | $42,500 ACV | Commit — PO submitted 04/23, expected sign within 7 days.
- NF-510 | NovaFoundry | $15,000 ACV | Commit-LowConfidence — Technical clarification outstanding, I moved to "Commit-Low" per guidelines.

I attached a quick call prep snippet in the Brightleaf thread — Sarah@brightleaf.com is fine to add if we need procurement visibility. For the ACME deal, I flagged finance@acmecorp.com under blockers because they requested a redline review.

On the agenda, add: "Procurement touchpoints — who owns the redline" under item 1.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Thanks for the clear asks, all. Quick update from finance: they want a one-line ARR delta explanation for any deal that moved >20% ACV from last week. I will send an export of the reconciliation sheet after the submission window closes.

Irene — can we add a 5-minute "Spreadsheet sanity check" at the top of the Tuesday agenda? Last cycle we had two stray currency-format rows that caused a reconciliation mismatch. Otherwise, I’ll confirm receipt of everyone's sheets by 4pm PT Wed and escalate any gaps.

Also adding this to the agenda: "Escalated legal cases (Acme redline, Brightleaf addendum) — owners & next steps."

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Revenue Finance | Redwood Inference
